brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Israel has declared war on kites flown by children in Gaza, creating a new flashpoint in the territory. The military escalation marks a significant shift in stated justifications for operations, following what observers characterize as exhausted pretexts for breaching ceasefire agreements and continuing civilian targeting in the enclave.

The move underscores mounting tensions surrounding the viability of any lasting agreement between the parties. Israeli officials have cited kites as a security threat, a characterization that has drawn scrutiny from international observers monitoring compliance with existing accords. The development signals potential fractures in ceasefire frameworks that had been negotiated to halt hostilities in Gaza.
